Sasha: Heads-up — planning a preemptive soft-swap of az12 gradient pools tomorrow 2026-03-21 03:00 UTC for a thermal probe on rack 12A. No full reboots; we'll do rolling handovers. Expect short throughput dips during cohort handoffs.

Marta: ETA per cohort?

Ken: 15–20m per cohort, staggered 3 racks at a time. Backfill policy will start immediately. We should keep >=60% pooled capacity available.

Amir: Quick question — cost impact if backfill uses spot vs reserved for those 2 hours?

Ken: Small spike, ballpark +6–8% token-cost for the maintenance window. I’ll post a tighter estimate once the scheduler sim runs.

infra-bot: Scheduled maintenance created: az12 soft-swap (non-disruptive) | Start: 2026-03-21 03:00 UTC | Est duration: 2h | Owner: Sasha

Sasha: Canary plan: start with grad-pool-canary (2 instances) in az12 to validate KV cache warmup and prefix cache retention. Abort criteria: p99 latency > 300ms for 5m or error-rate spike > 0.5%. Fallback: route traffic to az11 via smart-routing policy.

Marta: Are we running the old `kubectl drain` flow or the graceful-evac tool?

Ken: Use graceful-evac v2: `graceful-evac --pool gradient --cohort 12A --stage canary`. It handles KV prefetch, cache warmup, and safe token batching adjustments. Avoid manual `kubectl drain` unless debugging.

Amir: Runbook link: https://redwood.docs/runbooks/soft-swap-az12 — covers preflight checks, smoke tests, and rollback steps.

ops-oncall: I’ll be on watch for alerts and can bump temporary capacity if autoscaler lags. Pager is armed for the window.

Sasha: Preflight checklist: 01:00 UTC run on the canary (verify cache-hit >= 85%, p95 < 150ms). If green, proceed with staged cohorts at 03:00. Capture token-level latency, batch sizes, and cache-hit ratio in the evals dashboard and tag with #maintenance-az12.

Marta: Copy — updating external customer comms draft and posting to status page. :thumbsup:

Ken: Posted cost sim to the infra-costs board — estimated +7% token-cost during the 2h window, but we avoid the larger delta from full rack reboots (network warmup, recompile overhead).

Sasha: Sounds good. I’ll do a final preflight at 01:00 UTC and post a go/no-go. Ping me immediately if anything changes.

infra-bot: Reminder scheduled: will post 1h before window start.
